description: This Dart source file defines data structures and game logic for the front-end implementation of the 2048 puzzle game, including Tile and Board models, move directions, move and merge steps, and game logic functions such as starting a new game and applying moves.

classes.name: Tile
classes.description: Immutable model representing a single tile with position and value.

classes.name: Board
classes.description: Immutable representation of the 4x4 game grid, managing tiles placement, retrieval, and game state checks.

classes.name: MoveStep
classes.description: Details of a move action, from a source position to a destination.

classes.name: MergeStep
classes.description: Details of a merge action, indicating which tile was merged at which position.

classes.name: MoveResult
classes.description: Result of executing a move, including new board state, move and merge details, score gained, and game status flags.

classes.name: GameLogic
classes.description: Abstract class providing static methods to start a new game and perform moves, encapsulating core game mechanics.

methods.name: newGame
methods.description: Starts a new game with two randomly placed tiles.

methods.name: move
methods.description: Executes a move in the specified direction on a given board, producing the game result including new state, move details, and game status.
